text:
dave: FYI getting a big cluster of alerts from the IP reputation rule this morning, ~1.2k hits in 10m, mostly src IPs from a few GCP ranges. looks noisy.
monica: saw that, thanks. are these hitting customer-facing services or internal scanners?
arjun: initial enrichment shows asset.tag = \"ci-scan\" for ~60% of them. some others are cloud infra health checks. looks like recent cron increased our scan fanout.
dave: right — we launched a higher parallelism job yesterday. hunting to confirm, but likely FP. can we throttle the rule or suppress until we tune?
sec-bot: alert created: SIEM-IR-2026-089. Severity: medium. Incident channel: #incidents. Assigned: eng-security.
tori: proposal: add an exclusion for assets with tag `ci-scan` and add rate-based suppression: suppress per src_ip if < 20 events / 5m. also exclude known cloudhealth ASNs via enrichment.
monica: agree. can we do `where not asset.tags contains "ci-scan" and reputation_score > 70` instead of current >=30?
arjun: +1 for raising threshold. quick rule patch I suggest:
```
rule id: ip_reputation_v4
conditions:
  - reputation_score >= 70
  - not asset.tags contains "ci-scan"
  - not enrichment.asn in ["AS15169","AS14618"]  # google/aws ranges
rate_limit:
  - group_by: src_ip
    threshold: 20
    window: 300s
```
monica: maybe keep a separate monitoring rule that tracks the suppressed hits so we don't blind ourselves. push to a low-priority dashboard.
dave: good point. create `ip_rep_suppressed_count` metric whenever suppression happens; visualize 1d and 7d to catch regressions.
sec-bot: action logged: update runbook `siem/ip_reputation_runbook.md` with new suppression criteria. Owner required: eng-security oncall.
arjun: operational steps: 1) apply rule patch in staging, 2) run simulated scan with test IPs, 3) confirm suppressed_count metric increments, 4) deploy to prod with 30m monitor window.
tori: I'll own the staging test and dashboard update. @monica can you review the playbook text for comms wording (customer/no-customer impact)?
monica: will do. suggest phrasing: "We observed elevated detections from internal scanning job; detection thresholds adjusted to reduce FPs. No customer-facing compromise detected."
dave: after deploy, let's schedule a short post-mortem note in #all-hands-security with summary + follow-ups (automation to tag scanner assets upstream).
arjun: follow-ups: (a) tag CI scanners at provisioning time, (b) add ASN exclusion list fed by enrichment pipeline, (c) add unit test for reputation rule in SIEM CI.
sec-bot: incident closed: SIEM-IR-2026-089 -> mitigated. Notes: rule threshold increased; suppression enabled; dashboards added.
monica: thanks team. moving PR to review: `gitlab.com/redwood/siem/-/merge_requests/812` — label `eng-security` and `ops-approved`. will merge after tests.
dave: :thumbsup: good catch everyone.
